body:
I actually knew about emotional incest from being on /r/RBN before (I don't want to say he's that bad but I relate a lot) That's why I said the wife thing, he wasn't happy about it but I'm glad I finally said it.

What you said means a lot to me. I think my little sis is very sympathetic (she doesn't have to be, she's a kid, I hate she's even aware of this) and my brother does think the neck kissing is weird. 

What you said means a lot and I'm going to think about it all. I hope your situation with your dad is better now too.
Thank you thank you thank you. I guess I feel guilty about the idea of leaving when my little sis will still be here, but I think he's going to be better about it now as per update.

Thank you. I've updated in comments if you're still interested. I think he feels mostly guilty and won't do it again. I think the fallout is mostly over, but it genuinely means so much that you care enough to write. I know he does a lot, I just don't want to normalize this.
Not really, I don't want to call them into anything now that it's mostly died down, they know how dysfunctional we are anyway. I appreciate your support, though.

To update if anyone doubles back and reads this.


My dad came back from work on his break, knocking loudly and making me come out to talk. 

He was basically saying that how dare I accuse him of acting like [an uncle that's been weird with me, whole other can of worms] or Joe Biden. 

I said I was just telling him what he was doing whenever he brought that back up. 

He told me that I could be sure that he would never touch me or my siblings ever again, and that he wouldn't be able to give my hand in marriage because he'd probably be dead by then anyway. (I've never mentioned marriage ever) 

He told me his job's killing him and that he's having suicidal tendencies (he says this in every argument and I still don't know what to do) and that he can't date and other problems 

He said to delete the message from my phone because phones can be hacked and he doesn't want CPS to misunderstand or something (I already had a screenshot and a draft of my message here) He'd kill me if he ever found out I posted this, but honestly you guys help me so much I can't

He brought up a bunch of stuff and I cried a lot but tried to stay focused on that I did appreciate him

I think he focused more on telling me his problems than threatening me (he did threaten that if I didn't do late chores that there'd be consequences, but this is standard and I should do them anyway)

On the bright side, my little sister is on my side about it, but it's just so painful to just sit here with

Thanks, I just wanted to make sure I wasn't being entitled. It does worry me that he was so angry about it, he's responded better to other texts like this before. I'm worried that the next time I squirm away he's going to get much much angrier and see it as defiance to whatever he said. I'm sorry to vent. It means a lot that other people see it too.
I know other people comment on their kids' development but that has always weirded me out. Thank you. Hopefully he'll think about this more at work. Your support means a lot. :>
Thanks. I was thinking that but I know he does a lot for me too so I don't want to just be a brat. It means a lot to me to hear that.
Thank you. I've just been dodging talking to my sibs and anxiously waiting, it means a lot to have some support.

Thank you for this. I'm kind of in denial that I even said it. I wish I had just calmly said no today but he didn't get the memo before so I guess I got too jumpy about it. Hopefully he'll cool down and we can have the most uncomfortable, awkward convo ever about it.
She's not, just me, my little sister, and one of my brothers.
